hypotheses.R1_late_raw_concentration: At every common dimension, layer 17 has a larger raw top-four map-energy fraction than layers 0 and 8.
hypotheses.R2_late_natural_concentration: At every common dimension, layer 17 has a larger activation-weighted top-four map-energy fraction than layers 0 and 8.
hypotheses.R3_middle_requires_more_state_dimensions: At dimension 512, layer 8 whole-write centered R2 remains at least 0.10 below layer 17.
hypotheses.R4_fixed64_understates_early_fidelity: Increasing the state basis from 64 to 512 improves whole-write centered R2 by at least 0.20 at layers 0 and 8.
hypotheses.R5_raw_and_natural_rankings_agree: At full width, raw and activation-weighted top-four fractions rank the three layers in the same order.
hypotheses.R6_top_weight_component_is_naturally_rel: At every layer, the leading raw full-width output component is among the leading four activation-weighted output components by absolute cosine at least 0.70.
